findings.issue: Unit U25 was never applied (the file is unchanged from git_head_before), leaving all planned WYSIWYG integration tests for textStyles absent, including substring stroke/highlight styling and live .excalidraw-wysiwyg-preview span rendering, clearing range colour/highlight, collapsed-caret vs substring sticky-note ink isolation, sticky-note highlight popup isolation (openPopup === "textHighlight"), range shifting on typing and Tab/Shift+Tab indent/outdent, container resize/unwrapping, and undo/redo.
findings.fix: Import actionChangeStrokeColor and actionChangeTextHighlight from ../actions and add the planned describe("text range styles", ...) integration test suite in packages/excalidraw/wysiwyg/textWysiwyg.test.tsx covering all U25 scenarios.

findings.issue: RE_LTR_STRONG_OR_DIGIT classifies European digits 0-9 as strong "L" instead of weak European Numbers ("EN"). On an LTR-base line (baseDirection === "ltr") containing an RTL span with European digits (e.g. "Item: مرحبا 123 عالم"), resolveLineCharDirections and getLineTextRuns assign "123" and its adjacent spaces direction "ltr" at level 0 instead of resolving the spaces to "rtl" (level 1, per UAX#9 W2/N1) and the digits to level 2 (per UAX#9 I1/I2), splitting the RTL run in two so "مرحبا" and "عالم" fail to reverse visually around "123".
findings.fix: Treat ASCII digits [0-9] as weak "EN" in resolveLineCharDirections/getLineTextRuns: when the preceding strong character is "R", treat "EN" as "R" for adjacent neutral resolution (so spaces between "R" and "EN" get level 1 "rtl") while assigning the "EN" run direction "ltr" at embedding level 2, and split logical runs when either direction or level changes.

findings.issue: getLineTextRuns bidi tests only cover pure-RTL Arabic and an LTR-first line ending in an RTL span with Arabic-Indic digits ("Price: ١٢٠ درهم"), without testing European digits (0-9) inside RTL runs, neutrals between runs of opposite direction, or a line that starts and ends with LTR around an RTL span.
findings.fix: Extend the getLineTextRuns / projectTextRangesOntoLines test in packages/element/tests/textStyles.test.ts to assert visual run ordering for neutrals between opposite-direction runs, European digits (0-9) embedded inside RTL runs on both LTR-base and RTL-base lines, and an LTR-RTL-LTR line (e.g. "Hello مرحبا بالعالم World").

findings.issue: In actionChangeStrokeColor, the whole-text-selection guard (selection.start > 0 || selection.end < editingEl.originalText.length) routes full-text selections to the whole-element strokeColor branch, but that branch only updates el.strokeColor without clearing per-range color overrides in el.textStyles (or stripping redundant range colors matching the new strokeColor), without updating appState.editingTextElement, and PanelComponent also skips getUniformTextRangeStyle when the full text is selected.
findings.fix: When actionChangeStrokeColor.perform runs the whole-element branch on a text element with textStyles, clear range color across [0, el.originalText.length] (preserving highlight) if editingEl has a full-text selection [0, el.originalText.length] and otherwise normalize el.textStyles against the new strokeColor, update appState.editingTextElement when editingEl is mutated, and remove the (selection.start > 0 || selection.end < editingEl.originalText.length) restriction from PanelComponent's getUniformTextRangeStyle lookup.

findings.issue: Because actionChangeTextHighlight renders ColorPicker with type="elementBackground" (the only background ColorPickerType accepted by ColorPicker.tsx:215-234), starting the eyedropper from the highlight picker sets eyeDropperState.colorPickerType = "elementBackground", causing LayerUI.tsx:528-558 to preview pointer-dragged colors as backgroundColor on selected targets (such as a sticky note's fill while editing its label) before onSelect commits the text highlight.
findings.fix: Out of scope for the frozen allowlist (ColorPicker.tsx and LayerUI.tsx are not in the change plan); in a follow-up touching ColorPicker/LayerUI, thread a distinct eyedropper preview mode or skip element background preview when appState.openPopup === "textHighlight".
